title: DWG TEXT style name resolution
authority: ODA DWG v5.4.1 section 20.4.3 describes the TEXT STYLE handle as a hard pointer; section 20.4.56 specifies STYLE record fields.
problem: A registered custom STYLE name in DRW_Text::style was ignored when styleH was unset; the encoder selected STANDARD even when the named STYLE had been written.
scope: Only DRW::TEXT entities, excluding built-in DRW_RText, DRW_ArcAlignedText, DRW_Attrib/DRW_Attdef and DRW_MText even if their public type tag is changed. Registered style names match case-insensitively when styleH.ref and ref64 are zero. Existing explicit-handle precedence and unresolved-name STANDARD fallback remain. Name lookup is after existing early and legacy rejection guards, but before writer checkpoint reset, EED, or caller mutation; resolved drawing-local handle is restored after encoding on all exits. Compatible consumer TEXT subclasses remain accepted.
source_provenance: ezdxf 1.4.5 authored AC1021 DXF with CUSTOM arial.ttf STYLE and tilted, aligned TEXT; ODA File Converter 27.1 generated AC1021 DWG and AC1027 DXF. The conversion lineage is recorded locally; hashes bind artifacts individually and do not authenticate that lineage.
physical_results: LibreDWG 0.14 confirms source TEXT style role 5 resolves to CUSTOM; a baseline generated AC1021 with source-matching STYLE common metadata resolves to STANDARD; corrected generated TEXT resolves to CUSTOM. ODA AC1027 outputs independently confirm those style names and preserve sampled insertion/alignment, normal, rotation, oblique, width, flags and WCS alignment, with ezdxf audits free of errors and repairs. Generated controls use the existing material and plotstyle graph opt-ins. The corrected DWG was regenerated byte-for-byte after the lookup was moved, so the paired ODA result applies to the final bit-identical artifact.
style_metadata_limit: The working generated ODA case explicitly supplies STYLE xdictionary-missing=1 and typed role-5 null xref. The default caller-owned STYLE is unchanged and ODA rejects that baseline at the custom STYLE record. A scratch 2x2x2 factorial showed both metadata values required in this sampled case, regardless of old vs experimental exact footer; no separate STYLE framing change is claimed or included. No default metadata, arbitrary style-record, native rendering, or whole-file interoperability qualification is claimed.
test_results: Isolated ctest --test-dir /private/tmp/ac1021-hatch-edges/snapshot-build -R ^libdxfrw_dwg_text_style_resolution$ --output-on-failure passes 1/1 across AC1015/18/21/24/27/32. Unmodified writer failed the earlier four-TEXT selector at AC1015 readback. A later experimental variant that performed the lookup after handle reservation fails the final test: injected allocation failure changed the caller handle 0 to 50. Final tests inject std::bad_alloc during long-name lookup, verify unchanged caller handle, owner, style/layer/linetype handles and EED state, then retry on the same writer. They also cover case-insensitive names, explicit STANDARD handle, unknown-name fallback, invalid-owner failure/retry, caller styleH preservation, following LINE, compatible TEXT subclass and encode-time exclusion of the built-in non-TEXT descendants.
peer_validation: Three hash-bound source, baseline, corrected pairs pass; wrong hashes fail under Python -O. The independent audit invokes LibreDWG and ezdxf; ODA conversion lineage is not inferred from hashes.
reproduction: Use tools/author_ac1021_text_style_source.py <new-path> with ezdxf 1.4.5 to author equivalent source geometry; generated DXF metadata and hashes may vary.
Convert the source DXF directory to ACAD2007 DWG with ODA, then that DWG to ACAD2013 DXF; the recorded artifacts and hashes are listed below.

Compile the producer against the final library: c++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror -DSTYLE_T=1 -DSTYLE_X=1 -I<snapshot>/src -I<snapshot>/src/intern -I<snapshot>/tests <snapshot>/tools/probe_ac1021_text_style.cpp <build>/libdxfrw.a -o <new-producer>; invoke <new-producer> text <new-dwg>.
Convert the generated DWG to ACAD2013 DXF with ODA. Run the peer audit command above with the hashes of each exact pair and --generated-graph for generated DWGs.

Factorial producer builds use -DSTYLE_T=0 or 1 for untyped/typed null xref and -DSTYLE_X=0 or 1 for xdictionary present/missing, on either baseline or experimental exact-footer writer; only 11 produced DXF in each of the two batches.
integrated_validation: The six-version focused TEXT style, caller-state, failure and retry test passed 1/1 in the integrated build.
